Last week, good news for regular visitors
It concerns the desk
Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is handling pet travel support with extra care right now.

Travel plans can change fast, so please share any update about your companion animal as soon as it comes up. The team follows each booking from check-in to pickup, and the cabin crew keeps watch during flight. <<FACT F110>> If you are worried about boarding or a missed handoff, tell the desk at once so the supervisors can step in.

Please go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you travel.
